address: Na San Jao Market, Tonpo Road, Talat, Muaeng Surat Thani, Surat Thani, 84000, Thailand
bio: The veteran stall-owner has been making her delicious dumplings for decades in this famous food cart in Na San Jao market. The thin steamed rice dumplings combine a sweet, gooey texture with a savoury filling, made with minced pork, crushed peanuts and herbs in creamy coconut milk....
